summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting progress under the first tranche of its board-approved share buyback program, following the July 30, 2026 inside-information notice (CNMV reg. 3316). HSBC Continental Europe acts as tranche manager; between September 14 and 18, 2026, repurchases brought cumulative cash deployed to EUR 814,322,682.18, roughly 81.43% of the first tranche's maximum cash amount. The program was approved by the board on July 29, 2026. Watch for completion pacing, any subsequent tranches, and buyback-driven EPS accretion or capital-ratio effects.
